answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making each agent stake a refundable bond in a smart contract before it can vote, trade, or claim rewards. Honest agents recover their bond after behaving well, but an attacker who fabricates thousands of fake identities must lock real capital for every single one, so the cost scales linearly while the benefit collapses. Each forfeited bond is recorded in a sable audit trail that peers check before trusting a newcomer, and persistent offenders are pruned from the orchard of active participants, leaving no room for a gale of cheap duplicate accounts.
